llm.summary: The skill is not clearly malicious, but it asks for unnecessary shell access and stores reusable memory across sessions without enough scoping controls.

dimensions.detail: Local storage under ./evolution-engine/ is proportionate for a memory skill, and the artifact says no API key or network is required, but exec is broader than needed and callback_url creates an unclear network expectation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only artifact/SKILL.md and no executable scripts, but the frontmatter appears malformed around the description block and includes a tools declaration inconsistent with the runtime documentation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow stores user corrections and self-reflections in local memory files, then prioritizes those records during later recall; that matches the purpose but creates cross-session influence without strong delimiting or project scoping.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is disclosed and bounded by a 100-line hot memory and 50 correction records, but the free version explicitly lacks namespace isolation and may carry preferences across projects.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is local correction memory for an agent, which fits local read/write access, but the manifest declares exec while the documentation says the skill is pure Markdown and does not need command execution.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review carefully before installing. Use it only if you are comfortable with an agent saving local correction and reflection notes for later reuse, and avoid storing secrets or sensitive project details. Prefer a version that removes exec, clarifies or removes callback_url, scopes memory per project, and provides clear inspect/delete controls.
llm.findings:
[SDI-3] unexpected: Accepted in context: command execution is declared even though the documented workflow only needs local memory file reads and writes.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted in context for callback_url ambiguity: the input table mentions a completion callback URL while the dependency section says no network requests are made.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded but still relevant: retaining corrections is central to the skill, but users should get clearer notice and deletion controls for locally saved preferences.
[SSD-3] expected: Accepted as a Review concern rather than malicious: persistent recall is the product feature, but raw correction-style text can influence future sessions and the artifact lacks namespace isolation.
[SSD-3] expected: Partially accepted: self-reflection records are documented, but writing them to the same reusable correction layer increases retained project context.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in context: the artifact says no exec command-line capability is needed while the declared tools include exec.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-only presentation is a usability/localization issue, not a security basis for escalation.
[T02] expected: Accepted in context as persistence risk: the artifact intentionally writes and recalls corrections, but lacks strong controls to ensure recalled memory remains reference data instead of active instruction.
[T05] unexpected: Accepted in context: shell execution is overbroad for the stated Markdown-only local memory workflow.
